Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 73: August 2007
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #73 shipped to subscribers in July 2007 (bearing the cover date of August 2007 for Issue 73). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #73 delivered an action-heavy summer lineup of native high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, and exclusive media content:

Stuntman: Ignition (Hollywood stunt driver action-driving simulation)
FlatOut: Ultimate Carnage (demolition derby style combat racing)
All-Pro Football 2K8 (arcade-style gridiron football)
NASCAR 08 (stock car racing simulation)
Bomberman Live (Xbox Live Arcade multiplayer party action)
Wing Commander Arena (Xbox Live Arcade space combat action)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc delivered custom dashboard themes, gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—including E3 2007 coverage and featurettes for BioShock, Halo 3, Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, and Assassin's Creed, alongside OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
